parameters.content: When a lead's ClickUp status changes, stamp the matching stage in Postgres. Every lead must carry a SOURCE tag (meta, organic, referral, school) when it is created, or cost per qualified lead is a guess.

parameters.query:
UPDATE alcovia.leads SET
  qualified_at      = CASE WHEN $2 = 'qualified_at'      THEN COALESCE(qualified_at, now())      ELSE qualified_at END,
  discovery_set_at  = CASE WHEN $2 = 'discovery_set_at'  THEN COALESCE(discovery_set_at, now())  ELSE discovery_set_at END,
  discovery_held_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'discovery_held_at' THEN COALESCE(discovery_held_at, now()) ELSE discovery_held_at END,
  ambition_held_at  = CASE WHEN $2 = 'ambition_held_at'  THEN COALESCE(ambition_held_at, now())  ELSE ambition_held_at END,
  architect_held_at = CASE WHEN $2 = 'architect_held_at' THEN COALESCE(architect_held_at, now()) ELSE architect_held_at END,
  signed_up_at      = CASE WHEN $2 = 'signed_up_at'      THEN COALESCE(signed_up_at, now())      ELSE signed_up_at END,
  dropped_at        = CASE WHEN $2 = 'dropped_at'        THEN COALESCE(dropped_at, now())        ELSE dropped_at END
WHERE clickup_task_id = $1;
